nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 24 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations updated at 07:06 and 08:01 WAT on 25 Nov. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 24 Nov; mids read from the published table.

Kenya.note: CBK Daily KES commercial-banks' average closing rates, posted 24 Nov. Not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB HomePageRates weighted-average bank rates, 24 Nov; independently retrieved from the live endpoint.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 24 Nov, retrieved directly from the CBE table.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (24 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates (posted 24 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (24 Nov); Egypt CBE official buy/sell mid-rates (24 Nov).
